qa.q: Rory, do you like going out or staying at home?
qa.a: Um, to tell the truth, I'm much more of a homebody to be honest. Um, I rarely like going out to clubs these days because I'm a little bit past it and I hate loud music and crowds. Uh, it's the kind of combination that sort of makes your insides vibrate at the same time they're being crushed out of existence.

qa.q: Do you often go out in the evenings?
qa.a: Uh, almost never if I'm honest, unless I'm going to the gym and shopping and then walking back. Does that count? Uh, I think the last time I was in a club was about a month ago. Um, and it was like being in a time warp. I went in at 11 o'clock at night and emerged at 7:00 in the morning. And I have no idea how I managed to spend eight hours of my life in one place. I don't even spend that much time in bed normally.

qa.q: What do you like to do when you go out?
qa.a: I like talking to people. Hence why bars and clubs are annoying because you can scarcely hear yourself think. Uh, it was easier when I smoked because you could always nip outside and speak to people there. Uh, now I have to sort of yell over the din to make myself heard. I think the last time I was out I just sat and spoke to random people, including the barman actually.

qa.q: Do you prefer going out on your own or with friends?
qa.a: Ah, does anybody go out by themselves? Uh, I either go out with them or I meet them at whatever venue we picked. Um, and by 'we', I mean 'they' because I'm so old that all the places that I know closed down years ago probably.

qa.q: Do people in your country go out a lot?
qa.a: Well, not at the moment because of the lockdown restrictions, but if we speak more generally about times past, then yeah, they did. Uh, not just for fun either. People would go out walking or jogging or they would take dogs for a walk. Um, if you speak about recreational drinking, then it's like a famous thing in Scotland. Uh, some nights the town centers resemble a war zone.

qa.q: When do most young people like to go out in your country?
qa.a: Um, well, clubbing was popular. You used to have clubs for everything, like even certain age groups or fashion tastes, like you had um rock and sort of, um, I suppose grunge nightclubs, and people there would wear black and they'd be like gothic people there. And that was cool. Um, and of course there were times when people would just wander in groups of friends, and I imagine they still do when they can.
